Public facility recommendation system

Apr–Jun 2024

Our team applied Apriori and Eclat to anthropometric data on older adults in Indonesia, producing seven ergonomic rules for facility recommendations at GEMASTIK XVII.

Data mining

Approach

Our team analyzed body measurements from 182 older adults in Indonesia. The seven rules informed recommendations for chairs, stair handrails, and service counters. We advanced as one of 20 national Data Mining finalist teams.

Result or context

GEMASTIK XVII national finalist
